results.title: Controversy Surrounds CJP Founder Abhijit Dipke's Education Funding
results.description: The controversy surrounding Abhijit Dipke, founder of the Cockroach People Party (CJP), is escalating as he faces scrutiny over his education funding. Following allegations from an RTI activist questioning the financial background of his family, Dipke has firmly denied any wrongdoing, asserting that his studies in the US were financed through a scholarship and loans. As the investigation unfolds, he outlines CJP's future funding strategies and highlights support received during protests against the NEET paper leak. The situation raises questions about political motivations behind the complaints and the organization's financial transparency.
